name: loop
description: Run Claude-style prompt loops and project-specific closed loops for Codex work.

interface.shortDescription: Run recurring prompt loops with verification.
interface.longDescription: Loop helps Codex inspect a project, create a default loop prompt, run one bounded loop pass, draft Claude-style recurring prompt automations, design project-specific loop specs, and audit loop runs for verification quality, safety, cadence, and cost.
interface.defaultPrompt: $loop-init Analyze this project and create a Loop profile plus .loop/loop.md default prompt.
